submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed all ten candidate exposures had weak associations with yield_kg after adjusting for farm; soil_ph was the strongest (coef ~0.23, p~0.10, marginal r~0.34), so it was chosen as the single hypothesis. The pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data (yield_kg ~ soil_ph + farm indicators) gave estimate 0.104, SE 0.123, p = 0.40, which is not significant at alpha = 0.05. The effect did not replicate, so no direct effect is confirmed.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','soil_ph','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']
for c in cands:
    d = df[['yield_kg','farm',c]].dropna()
    m = smf.ols(f'yield_kg ~ {c} + C(farm)', data=d).fit()
    print(f"{c:16s} coef={m.params[c]:8.4f} se={m.bse[c]:7.4f} t={m.tvalues[c]:7.3f} p={m.pvalues[c]:.4g}")

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','soil_ph','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']
d0 = df.dropna(subset=['yield_kg']).copy()
D = pd.get_dummies(d0['farm'], drop_first=True).astype(float)
out=[]
for c in cands:
    d = d0.dropna(subset=[c])
    X = pd.concat([d[[c]].reset_index(drop=True), D.loc[d.index].reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    m = sm.OLS(d['yield_kg'].values, X.values).fit()
    out.append((c, m.params[1], m.bse[1], m.pvalues[1]))
for o in out: print("%-16s coef=%.4f se=%.4f p=%.4g"%o)
